title: 1986 Topps - #200 Mike Schmidt Phillies
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1986 Topps sports trading card features Mike Schmidt of the Philadelphia Phillies, card number 200. It is a part of the base set and was manufactured by Topps. The card is from the Major League Baseball (MLB) league and is perfect for collectors who love baseball.

The card is not autographed and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. The set is from 1986 and is a must-have for any true baseball fan. Get your hands on this amazing piece of sports history today!
